notes.title: Contents update BETA version
notes.content:
Hello,

I am preparing for a new content update.
The new content update includes [b]4 stages[/b], and [b]a total of 7 stages[/b] will be available to play.
You can play the BETA version with the new content update on the Steam client in advance (there may be bugs).

[url=https://discord.com/channels/953877849092259880/1125437167506829402]How to play BETA[/url]

The BETA version will be changed to the official version after bug testing.

Included in the update :
- Addition of 4 stages
- More cards and recipes

The main goal of this game is to [b]Escape[/b], and survival is a tool to achieve that escape.
The first stage, which is also playable in the demo version, aims to provide familiarity, so there is only 1 very simple obstacle prepared.

From the second stage, which can be played in the full version, the process of dismantling obstacles becomes more complex.
I hope you can decipher this process based on the materials alone,
but sometimes it can be quite painful, so I provide hints in the quest and recipe windows.

The publicly available recipes that can be obtained during gameplay account for about [b]20%[/b] of the total recipes.
Look for various hidden recipes that cannot be found in the list of recipe window.(It does not exist with the card)

The publicly available recipe for producing Embers is [b]Straw + Convex lens + Sun[/b], but in reality, there are [b]over 10 different recipes[/b] to make Embers.
For example) instead of Straw, you can use paper types or dried leaves, and instead of a convex lens and the sun, you can use two wooden sticks as traditionally known. It's a secret, but the easiest way is to use a disposable lighter.

I sincerely thank all of you who are interested in and have played an unfinished game.
You can always chat on Discord.
[url=https://discord.gg/XTDZTwWWM6]Join Discord[/url]

Thank you.

tags.feature: - Addition of 4 stages
- More cards and recipes

notes.title: Partial limitations on the number of cards
notes.content:
Hello.
To improve the inconvenience, I have modified some restrictions.

Partial limitations on the number of cards:
- Cards in the inventory can be placed on the floor without any limit.
- Equipped cards can be placed on the floor without any limit.
- A new card can only be found with a 'search' card if there are less than 7 cards on the floor.

Overlapping inventory cards:
- Cards in the inventory can be placed directly on top of cards on the floor.
- Cards in the inventory can be linked directly with a card on the floor.

You can rest and restore health at small campfires, campfires, and fireplaces (Note: campfires can go out over time).
The portability of wet charcoal has decreased.

Fixed a combination error related to the sea.
Fixed an issue with straw fish trap hunting in the sea.
Fixed an issue with straw net hunting in the sea.

Anyone can share their thoughts or bugs about the game on Discord.

The play time of the demo version has been increased to 3 days. The game is so difficult that surviving 3 days is not easy.

Scenario cards have been added. The text on the back of the card tells the story behind the player trapped on the island. Scenarios do not affect clearing this game, but special item cards that appear depending on the scenario can help clear the game more easily.

* Fixed animal attack damage error.
* Fixed an error where stamina values were not displayed correctly.
* Fixed an error where the number on the back of the card was not displayed completely.
* Fixed a name notation error in the recipe list.


[b]Ready for the next update[/b]
* New cards and combination formulas.
* Stage act 2.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Portuguese and Polish translations are planned.

notes.title: Stack Island : Update 3
notes.content:
Hello.

The existence of combination formulas and the probability of card appearance have a significant impact on the difficulty. For example, while cultivating plants like strawberries to secure food is an ideal gameplay method, it becomes unnecessary to cultivate them when there are too many.
Currently, the game seems to be on the difficult side. No player has filled the two days of gameplay provided in the demo version. There may be various reasons, but it seems that the size of the inventory and the number of cards that can be used in one location have the biggest impact on the difficulty. I am considering how to adjust this.

Anyone can share your thoughts or bugs about the game on Discord.
[url=https://discord.gg/XTDZTwWWM6]https://discord.gg/XTDZTwWWM6[/url]

------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]Update details :[/b]
* Merged all types of protein obtained from animals into one.
* Can make thread from spider webs.
* Rainwater card will be replaced with a puddle when the rain stops.
* Drinking water from a puddle leaves soil.
* Drying puddles in the sun leaves soil.
* Sun-drying a rotten puddle also leaves soil.
* When an animal steals food and runs away, it leaves behind feces.
* Including feces in plant cultivation speeds up the growth rate.
* Can use walnuts with a slingshot.
* Throwing sea creatures into the sea does not contaminate them.
* Contaminated plastic bags can be washed and reused with rainwater.
* Can eat rotten coconuts by breaking them.
* Can use broken branches as wood material.
* Added bones from large animals.
* The method of using the escape card has been changed from clicking to combination.
* The description of all cards has been changed to information that allows deduction of combination formulas.

[b]Bug fixes :[/b]
* Fixed issue where durability was incorrectly displayed on the back of cards.
* Fixed issue where the background color of some cards was not displayed.
* Fixed issue where damage value and sound effect were not displayed when a low-health animal dies. * Fixed issue that occurred when restarting.

[b]Next update preparation :[/b]
* Scenario cards that provide clues to escape the island.
* Forced exposure of some important cards (sea, rock, etc.).
* Addition of numerous cards and combination formulas.
* Display of contamination level on the screen when it is high.
* Addition of a new method for making fire.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

There is someone on Stack Island who has promised Portuguese and Polish translations. The translation work has not started because the contents of the game have not yet been sorted out, but if nothing special happens, it will be translated into Portuguese and Polish.

notes.title: Stack Island : Update 1
notes.content:
Hello.

After the demo version was released, various bugs were discovered based on the play of some players. Several problems that prevented normal play when restarting the game have been resolved, and a serious problem with cards being copied was also found.

You can share your opinions or bugs about the game on our Discord.
[url=https://discord.gg/XTDZTwWWM6]https://discord.gg/XTDZTwWWM6[/url]

I collected the opinions of those who enjoyed the game and included them in my to-do list, and prioritized revealing cards that allow you to return to the way you came when you used a location transfer card.

0.598 version
* The card will be revealed in advance so that you can go back the way you came.
* Animals do not appear in areas with fires at night.
* Even if you don't have a watch, a 'danger' notice is displayed on the screen at night. (In the demo version, the time is always displayed)
* Fixed an issue with doubling inventory cards after restarting the game.
* Fixed an issue where inventory usage did not decrease even when using inventory cards.
* The function of the button to go to the lobby in settings has been activated.

Stack Island has someone who promised Portuguese and Polish translations. The translation work has not started because the contents of the game have not been organized yet, but if nothing special happens, it will be translated into Portuguese and Polish.
